summary: Co-Diagnostics filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 on September 15, 2026, disclosing an August 2026 material transfer agreement with ReadyGo Diagnostics Ltd to evaluate compatibility of ReadyGo's sample collection and preparation technologies with the company's Co-Dx PCR platform. The arrangement is a preliminary feasibility study; ReadyGo provides sampling materials, and no development, supply or commercialization obligation arises. No securities, ownership stake, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation is involved. This is an ordinary technology-evaluation disclosure, not a special situation.
